keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Unai López (Rayo Vallecano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Rayo Vallecano 1, Celta Vigo 0. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Sergio Camello with a through ball following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Hugo González (Celta Vigo).
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Pablo Durán replaces Hugo González because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Giorgi Tsitaishvili replaces Álvaro García.
Goal! Rayo Vallecano 2, Celta Vigo 0. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Andrei Ratiu.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Isi Palazón replaces Sergio Camello.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Iago Aspas replaces Javi Galán.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Jozhua Vertrouwd replaces Adrià Pedrosa.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Sergio Carreira replaces Ferran Jutglà.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Williot Swedberg replaces Sebastián Cáceres.
Delay in match because of an injury Óscar Valentín (Rayo Vallecano).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Gnangoro replaces Óscar Valentín because of an injury.
Gnangoro (Rayo Vallecano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Rayo Vallecano 3, Celta Vigo 0. Unai López (Rayo Vallecano) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Gnangoro following a fast break.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Couhaib Driouech replaces Hugo Álvarez.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Alemão replaces Unai López.
Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Rayo Vallecano 3, Celta Vigo 0.
